Why we invested in Lumio

Marmik Mankodi
Published
7 Oct 2026
Reading Time
3 minutes
Contents
  • Lumio is taking on a huge market
  • The first year
  • TLDR: software people use
  • Founders who have done this before
  • Why we led the investment

Lumio has raised their Series A of $12M led by us at Blume Ventures (Fund V). 

We’re backing Raghu Reddy and Kailash Sankaranarayan as they build India’s next big consumer electronics brand.

India has lived with sub-optimal TV and screen-based experiences for a long time. Remotes lag, apps take time to open, and the home screen is slow to scroll. We have just got used to it.

Raghu and Kailash wanted to change that. Lumio began with high-end smart TVs and home entertainment, one of the largest consumer categories in India and also one where the products have improved very little. Their approach is the flagship killer playbook applied to TVs and projectors: a better display and faster performance than the incumbents, at great value. Their customer is the India1 buyer who spends three or four hours on YouTube reviews and Reddit threads before spending ₹30,000 to ₹50,000 on a TV.
